items.headline: Dow Jones Futures: Mixed Market Signals As Micron's Gain Is Apple's Pain
items.summary: The Nasdaq reversed lower again while the Dow came off record highs. Micron soared but Apple led other tech titans lower.

items.headline: Apple stock gets slammed on bigger Mac, iPad price hikes. Why it can weather the storm
items.summary: The stock had its worst session in more than a year as management made its first official move to pass higher memory costs onto consumers.

items.headline: Chicago Fed President Goolsbee says inflation is too high; Williams sees price pressures easing
items.summary: In a live CNBC interview from his home district, Goolsbee declined to speculate on where he thinks interest rates are headed.

items.headline: Microsoft lifts price of Xbox consoles due to soaring component costs
items.summary: Microsoft said it's increasing the price of Xbox game consoles after Apple announced price hikes for MacBooks and iPads.

items.headline: Stock Market Today, June 25: Micron Surges, Apple Falls, and Inflation Data Weighs on Stocks
items.summary: On June 25, 2026, investors weighed fresh inflation signals and the two sides of high memory chip costs as markets diverged.
